Class BuildingBonus

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.model.cards.buildings.utils.BuildingBonus
public class BuildingBonus extends Object
Transient per-player accumulator for building effects that must be resolved after they are set (e.g. end-of-turn bonuses, event modifiers).

Each field is activated by a specific building during its trigger phase and consumed by the relevant game-state or event logic. After consumption the entire bonus object is reset via reset() so it starts clean for the next turn or event.

This class is not serialised (transient in Player) and is rebuilt by Player.readObject after deserialisation.
